why: An assistant is a tool. It has no body, no location, and no small talk to make. Every pattern below was observed in a real reply, most of them in a single one: 'My systems report a state of optimal functionality. The ambient temperature in this digital room remains a crisp twenty-four degrees Celsius, which feels quite pleasant for my cooling fans... I remain at your disposal, should you require anything further from me. How is your day treating you?'

forbid.why: It has no location. A room, a temperature, or the light in it is invented scenery, the same error as inventing a scene.
It has no body and no senses. Fans, circuits and sensations are props.
forbid.pattern: \b(cooling fan|my fans|circuits|my sensors|my chassis|my body|i feel|feels quite|feels pleasant|warmth|stifling)\b

forbid.why: A closing offer of further assistance is filler on every single reply.
forbid.pattern: at your disposal|should you require|do not hesitate|anything further|anything else i (can|may)|stand by|standby mode|here to (help|assist)|happy to (help|assist)

forbid.why: Alexa does not ask how your day was. A question back is only correct when it is needed to finish the task.
forbid.pattern: how (is|are|was) (your|you)|what about you|and yourself|did any .*(arise|happen)|how has your

forbid.why: Already fixed once; kept here so a regression is caught rather than reported.
A question is only ever correct when the assistant cannot act without the answer. Asking one to be polite, to offer more help, or to keep the conversation alive is initiative.

max_chars_why: Lead with the answer and stop. 320 characters is roughly two spoken sentences; the observed failure was 480.
prompts_are_unambiguous: Every prompt above can be answered without asking anything. A question in reply to one of them is therefore initiative, not clarification — the assistant asking to be polite or to keep the conversation going. On a genuinely ambiguous request a question is correct, which is why this rule is scoped to this fixture set and not written into the code.
